style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=PingFang SC;fontSize=21;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=10;fillColor=#FFF4DF;strokeColor=#7890A3;fontColor=#243B4D;"><mxGeometry x="340"
